capabilities.name: Versioned project contract
capabilities.description: Define and enforce the versioned .plproj project manifest and shared project data contract.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.1.3 — Project Format Contract
capabilities.notes: Versioned project and subsystem persistence contracts, resource states, corruption detection, checksums, journals, repair entry points, and transactional project import are implemented.

capabilities.name: Project schema migration
capabilities.description: Safely migrate older supported project and slice schemas with backup and atomic replacement.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.1.3 — Project Format Contract
capabilities.notes: Migration boundary, future-version rejection, pre-migration backups, atomic replacement, and migration-safe project loading are established. Schema v1 is the current baseline, so no historical v0-to-v1 migration exists.

capabilities.name: Shared RPC contract
capabilities.description: Provide a stable renderer-to-main RPC contract with structured responses and typed failure behavior.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.1.4 — RPC and Error Boundaries
capabilities.notes: Wave 1.1.4 establishes authenticated loopback transport, structured JSON-RPC responses, typed failures, method contracts, parameter validation, runtime permission authorization, bounded retries, timeout and cooperative cancellation behavior, progress reporting, structured diagnostics, application-owned RPC lifecycle, and backend integration coverage. Process-level worker, engine, and extension isolation remain later platform work.

capabilities.name: Unified application shell
capabilities.description: Provide shared navigation, workspace layout, slice switching, project context, status, commands, and application-level UI infrastructure.
capabilities.source: Shared Creator Platform Foundations
capabilities.notes: The current shell works but remains heavily concentrated in App.tsx and requires decomposition and shared-component cleanup.

capabilities.name: Shared asset system
capabilities.description: Track project assets, metadata, dependencies, linked and embedded states, missing assets, and reusable asset references.
capabilities.source: Shared Creator Platform Foundations / Assets
capabilities.notes: A shared asset service exists, but the complete cross-slice asset contract is not finished.

capabilities.name: Cross-slice project links
capabilities.description: Provide durable references between documents, sheets, source files, models, animation assets, game assets, and shared project data.
capabilities.source: Cross-Slice Integration and Workflow Convergence
capabilities.notes: Links must survive save, reopen, rename, migration, and missing-asset states.

capabilities.name: Shared history autosave and recovery
capabilities.description: Provide reusable undo history, snapshots, autosave, crash recovery, and restore behavior.
capabilities.source: Shared Creator Platform Foundations / History and Recovery
capabilities.notes: Individual slices should consume this shared infrastructure rather than invent unrelated recovery systems.

capabilities.name: Shared import and export framework
capabilities.description: Provide reusable importer, exporter, conversion, validation, progress, error, and format-registration infrastructure.
capabilities.source: Shared Creator Platform Foundations / Import Export

capabilities.name: Background task and worker system
capabilities.description: Execute long-running work with progress, cancellation, diagnostics, lifecycle state, and failure isolation.
capabilities.source: Shared Creator Platform Foundations / Tasks Workers Diagnostics
capabilities.notes: Some engine operations exist, but the standard suite-wide job contract remains incomplete.

capabilities.name: Shared command system
capabilities.description: Register application and slice commands for menus, shortcuts, command palette, automation, and future extensions.
capabilities.source: Shared Creator Platform Foundations / Reusable UI Infrastructure

capabilities.name: Permissions and trust framework
capabilities.description: Gate sensitive filesystem, process, network, AI, extension, and workspace operations through explicit permissions and trust.
capabilities.source: Extension System and Security Model
capabilities.notes: Security boundaries exist in parts of the application but are not yet represented by one complete permission framework.

capabilities.name: Extension platform
capabilities.description: Provide extension discovery, lifecycle, APIs, permissions, compatibility, installation, and isolation.
capabilities.source: Extension Platform
capabilities.notes: Plugin registry infrastructure exists; the complete public extension contract and marketplace-facing platform do not.

capabilities.name: Project-aware Copilot framework
capabilities.description: Provide permissioned project context, tool invocation, proposal review, patch review, and user-controlled AI actions.
capabilities.source: Project-Aware Copilot
capabilities.notes: AI infrastructure exists experimentally, but official-v1 project-aware action contracts remain incomplete.

capabilities.name: Shared rendering infrastructure
capabilities.description: Provide common render jobs, preview state, output configuration, progress, cancellation, and diagnostics where practical.
capabilities.source: Shared Engine Infrastructure
capabilities.notes: Modeling and Movie engine foundations exist, but a stable suite-level render contract is not yet complete.

capabilities.name: Shared media infrastructure
capabilities.description: Provide reusable audio, video, media metadata, timing, decoding, preview, and asset-handling contracts.
capabilities.source: Movie Animation and Game Shared Media Requirements
capabilities.notes: Movie and Game foundations already model media-related state, but shared production-grade media infrastructure remains incomplete.

capabilities.name: Shared geometry foundation
capabilities.description: Provide reusable geometry representations and operations needed by modeling, rendering, physics, and game asset workflows.
capabilities.source: Modeling and Shared Engine Foundations
capabilities.notes: Scene/object geometry foundations exist, but production mesh operation contracts remain incomplete.

capabilities.name: Shared physics and simulation infrastructure
capabilities.description: Provide reusable simulation state, bodies, colliders, stepping, diagnostics, and physics integration contracts.
capabilities.source: Physics Simulation Engine Foundations
capabilities.notes: Physics foundations exist, but full Modeler and Game integration remains incomplete.

capabilities.name: Shared timeline and keyframe primitives
capabilities.description: Provide reusable timing, playback, track, keyframe, range, marker, and interpolation concepts.
capabilities.source: Movie Animation Engine Foundations
capabilities.notes: Animation engine primitives exist; reusable cross-slice timeline contracts remain incomplete.

capabilities.name: Calculation and dependency graph foundation
capabilities.description: Provide deterministic dependency tracking and recalculation infrastructure for formula-driven data.
capabilities.source: Spreadsheet Formula Engine Requirements
capabilities.notes: Initially consumed by Spreadsheets but defined separately so later project data systems can reuse the dependency model.

capabilities.name: Shared diagnostics infrastructure
capabilities.description: Provide structured diagnostic events, logging, warnings, errors, task state, and engine health visibility.
capabilities.source: Shared Creator Platform Foundations / Tasks Workers Diagnostics
capabilities.notes: Multiple engines already expose diagnostic information, but one stable shared contract is still needed.

capabilities.name: Shared accessibility infrastructure
capabilities.description: Provide reusable keyboard navigation, focus behavior, semantic controls, scaling, and accessibility patterns.
capabilities.source: Shared Creator Platform Foundations / Accessibility and UI Infrastructure
capabilities.notes: Existing UI provides portions of standard desktop behavior but has not completed the formal accessibility pass.

capabilities.name: Typed event bus
capabilities.description: Provide a versioned typed event bus for project, asset, slice, engine, task, terminal, extension, AI, cloud, collaboration, and platform events.
capabilities.source: v1.2 — Wave 1.2.2 Command registry event bus settings and capability services

capabilities.name: Scoped settings system
capabilities.description: Provide application, profile, project, slice, language, extension, and provider settings scopes through stable shared contracts.
capabilities.source: v1.2 — Wave 1.2.2 Command registry event bus settings and capability services

capabilities.name: Global project search
capabilities.description: Provide project-wide search across files, documents, cells, symbols, assets, scenes, shots, tasks, workflows, and extension content.
capabilities.source: v1.2 — Wave 1.2.3 Project asset indexing and global search services

capabilities.name: Background indexing service
capabilities.description: Provide incremental background indexing with content hashing, stale detection, cancellation, status reporting, and update tracking.
capabilities.source: v1.2 — Wave 1.2.3 Project asset indexing and global search services

capabilities.name: Shared notification service
capabilities.description: Provide consistent application and project notifications through a stable internal Notification API.
capabilities.source: v1.2 — Required outcomes and Wave 1.2.6 Initial platform SDK contracts

capabilities.name: Permission-aware service registry
capabilities.description: Provide versioned service registration and permission-aware service discovery instead of direct cross-module imports.
capabilities.source: v1.2 — Wave 1.2.2 Command registry event bus settings and capability services

capabilities.name: Local operational telemetry
capabilities.description: Provide locally stored operational telemetry and diagnostics with explicit opt-in boundaries for any future cloud diagnostic transmission.
capabilities.source: v1.2 — Shared Creator Platform required outcomes
capabilities.notes: Operational telemetry remains local unless the user explicitly opts into a future external diagnostic flow.

capabilities.name: Shared theme API
capabilities.description: Provide a stable internal Theme API for shared UI styling, extension integration, workspace behavior, accessibility, and future SDK consumers.
capabilities.source: v1.2 — Wave 1.2.6 Initial platform SDK contracts

capabilities.name: Shared template API
capabilities.description: Provide stable project, slice, workflow, and extension-facing template contracts for reusable creator content and workflows.
capabilities.source: v1.2 — Wave 1.2.6 Initial platform SDK contracts
